name: Breast Implant-Associated Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Diagnostic Criteria for BIA-ALCL

criteria.description: Presence of large anaplastic lymphoid cells with hallmark morphology on histopathological examination
CD30 positivity and ALK negativity on immunohistochemistry
Late-onset peri-implant seroma or mass occurring years after breast implantation
Ultrasound or MRI showing peri-implant fluid collection or mass

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of large anaplastic lymphoid cells with CD30 positivity and ALK negativity in the context of a peri-implant seroma or mass
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of systemic ALCL and other lymphomas; implant history is essential.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically occurs several years after implant placement
Palpable mass adjacent to the implant

pathognomonic.symptomName: CD30-positive large anaplastic lymphoid cells in peri-implant fluid or tissue
pathognomonic.notes: Diagnostic hallmark on cytology or biopsy
searchTerms: large atypical lymphoid cells in implant fluid

common.symptomName: Breast pain localized to implant area

common.notes: Due to fluid accumulation or mass effect

common.symptomName: Seroma fluid cytology showing atypical lymphocytes

occasional.symptomName: Systemic B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)
searchTerms: general body symptoms like fever and sweating
feeling very tired due to disease
bone marrow infiltration by abnormal cells
blood cell production affected by marrow involvement

laboratory: Cytology of peri-implant fluid showing large atypical lymphoid cells
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD30 and negative for ALK
Elevated serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) in some cases
imaging: Ultrasound showing peri-implant fluid collection or mass
MRI demonstrating implant capsule abnormalities and masses
PET-CT for staging and detecting systemic involvement
other: Histopathology revealing hallmark large anaplastic lymphoid cells
Capsule fibrosis and inflammation surrounding implant

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of atypical lymphoid cells on cytology

redFlags: Persistent late-onset peri-implant seroma beyond one year post-implant
Presence of CD30-positive large atypical lymphoid cells in seroma fluid
references: Clemens MW, et al. NCCN Consensus Guidelines on the Diagnosis and Treatment of BIA-ALCL. J Natl Compr Canc Netw. 2020.
Deva AK, et al. Breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma: a review and recommendations for diagnosis and management. Plast Reconstr Surg. 2017.
Orphanet: Breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ORPHA:667662)
